description.narrative: Climate Smart Jobs is a transformative initiative aimed at revolutionalising the agri-business sector in Northern Uganda. Funded by the UK Government’s International Climate Fund, the programme focuses on creating resilient and sustainable on-farm and off-farm job opportunities.

activity-date.narrative: The initial planned end date is 30 Sept 2027

recipient-country.narrative: To provide services to to Ugandan households and business in particular those household and business for which there is highest potential to support economic empowerment of women and refugees.
